4PX freight is settled in CNY and kept separate from Etsy’s payout ledger. Use + 4PX shipping above to deduct it from net.
How pricing works

Each order is priced from 4PX’s live rate card (ds.xms.estimated_cost.get) and marked estimated; after settlement it becomes billed via ds.xms.order.getFreight. Combined view converts CNY into each shop’s payout currency at the current rate.

How to read these figures

Earnings come from each shop’s Etsy payment-account ledger in that shop’s payout currency. Net profit, Sales, Fees & deductions, and Marketing follow the selected period. The calendar month line (when shown) is always 1st → today, independent of the period. Current balance is the live payment-account balance and ignores the date filter. Ads are shop-level (in Marketing / the breakdown), not per order.

    What this page can and cannot see

    Manual mode is the default and makes zero Etsy API calls. Paste aggregate visits, views, orders, revenue, conversion, optional shop-health figures, and optional per-listing Stats tables from Etsy Shop Manager. Raw pasted text is discarded; only normalized aggregate metrics are stored locally. Etsy’s API Terms §§5(24)–(25) use broad written-authorization requirements for automated analysis and API analytics. Optional API collection remains disabled unless both etsy_api_analytics_approved and catalog_health_sync are explicitly true; written scope confirmation is also recommended for this local seller-directed analysis. UED cannot infer search rank or traffic source from the Open API.

    How parcel health and refresh timing work

    4PX checks run independently in the background. Recent pre-transit parcels are checked more frequently to detect pickup; moving parcels use a longer cache window, and older open parcels receive a low-frequency check until 4PX reports a terminal state or they are archived. Official 4PX event codes, descriptions and locations are evaluated together. A parcel is stuck when 4PX reports a critical exception, an active customs hold has not cleared, or carrier updates stop. Destination and last-mile parcels receive a longer grace period, but silence alone is never treated as proof of delivery. A label 4PX has never scanned/accepted by the configured threshold is Label only instead — that is a drop-off gap on our side, not a carrier stall, so it has its own count and never needs a buyer message. Disposed includes official destruction/abandonment events and has its own compensation queue, excluded from the Stuck count. Actionable open parcels are hidden when they fall outside the selected period — choose All dates to review the full stuck or disposed backlog. Claim notes are private operational notes and stay separate from Orders/Route team notes.

    API Budget
    The 5,000/day limit explained

    Etsy gives every API app 5,000 calls per 24 hours — per API key, not per shop. If you have 5 shops using the same key, they all share one 5,000-call bucket.

    It is a sliding window, not a fixed midnight reset. If you use 1,000 calls at 9 AM, those 1,000 slots open back up at 9 AM the next day. The budget refills gradually throughout the day, not all at once.

    What uses calls? Every time the dashboard fetches orders, checks tracking status, refreshes inventory, or sends a shipment update to Etsy — each one costs 1 call. Background syncs are the biggest consumer.

    Why do I get blocked? When the budget runs out, the dashboard pauses background syncs automatically (shown as amber "Rate-limited" on the shop card). Critical actions like completing orders still go through using a reserved pool. The dashboard resumes on its own as the window rolls forward and budget is freed up — typically within a few minutes to an hour.

    The history below shows every Etsy call we made, newest first. The Reason column tells you what each call was for (fetching orders, checking inventory, syncing messages, shipping an order, etc.). Remaining is how many calls Etsy said were left right after that call, and Calls used is the change since the previous reading. A green "+N (window released)" means the rolling 24-hour window freed up old calls — your budget actually went up.

        Enter Packing Mode
        Packing Mode hides everything except the order queue, so your packer sees only what to pack and ship. Owner tools, earnings and settings are hidden.
